    11	/-!
    12	# Realification of complex manifold models
    13	
    14	The integral-curve API in Mathlib is formulated for real manifolds. This file
    15	forgets the complex scalar structure of a model with corners while retaining
    16	the same partial equivalence and charts. Complex differentiability then
    17	implies real differentiability, so manifold and Lie-group structures transfer
    18	to the realified model.
    19	-/
    20	
    21	set_option autoImplicit false
    22	
    23	noncomputable section
    24	
    25	open scoped Manifold ContDiff
    26	
    27	namespace Mumford
    28	namespace Analytic
    29	
    30	variable {E H : Type*}
    31	  [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E]
    32	  [TopologicalSpace H]
    33	
    34	/-- The real model with corners obtained from a complex model by restricting
    35	scalars and keeping its partial equivalence unchanged. -/
    36	def complexToRealModel (I : ModelWithCorners ℂ E H) :
    37	    ModelWithCorners ℝ E H :=
    38	  ModelWithCorners.ofConvexRange I.toPartialEquiv I.source_eq
    39	    (by simpa only [I.target_eq] using I.convex_range)
    40	    I.continuous I.continuous_symm
    41	    (by simpa only [I.target_eq] using I.nonempty_interior)
    42	
    43	/-- Every complex-smooth coordinate change is smooth for the realified model. -/
    44	theorem contDiffGroupoid_complex_le_real
    45	    (I : ModelWithCorners ℂ E H) (n : ℕ∞ω) :
    46	    contDiffGroupoid n I ≤ contDiffGroupoid n (complexToRealModel I) := by
    47	  intro e he
    48	  change
    49	    ContDiffOn ℂ n (I ∘ e ∘ I.symm)
    50	        (I.symm ⁻¹' e.source ∩ Set.range I) ∧
    51	      ContDiffOn ℂ n (I ∘ e.symm ∘ I.symm)
    52	        (I.symm ⁻¹' e.target ∩ Set.range I) at he
    53	  change
    54	    ContDiffOn ℝ n
    55	        (complexToRealModel I ∘ e ∘ (complexToRealModel I).symm)
    56	        ((complexToRealModel I).symm ⁻¹' e.source ∩
    57	          Set.range (complexToRealModel I)) ∧
    58	      ContDiffOn ℝ n
    59	        (complexToRealModel I ∘ e.symm ∘ (complexToRealModel I).symm)
    60	        ((complexToRealModel I).symm ⁻¹' e.target ∩
    61	          Set.range (complexToRealModel I))
    62	  exact ⟨he.1.restrict_scalars ℝ, he.2.restrict_scalars ℝ⟩
    63	
    64	/-- A complex manifold is a real manifold for the realified model and the
    65	same charted-space structure. -/
    66	instance complexToRealModel_isManifold
    67	    {M : Type*} [TopologicalSpace M] [ChartedSpace H M]
    68	    (I : ModelWithCorners ℂ E H) (n : ℕ∞ω) [IsManifold I n M] :
    69	    IsManifold (complexToRealModel I) n M := by
    70	  letI : HasGroupoid M (contDiffGroupoid n (complexToRealModel I)) :=
    71	    hasGroupoid_of_le
    72	      (inferInstance : HasGroupoid M (contDiffGroupoid n I))
    73	      (contDiffGroupoid_complex_le_real I n)
    74	  exact IsManifold.mk' (complexToRealModel I) n M
    75	
    76	/-- Boundarylessness is unchanged by realification. -/
    77	instance complexToRealModel_boundaryless
    78	    (I : ModelWithCorners ℂ E H) [I.Boundaryless] :
    79	    (complexToRealModel I).Boundaryless where
    80	  range_eq_univ := by
    81	    change Set.range I = Set.univ
    82	    exact I.range_eq_univ
    83	
    84	/-- A complex manifold derivative remains a manifold derivative after
    85	restricting scalars to `ℝ`. -/
    86	theorem HasMFDerivAt.restrict_scalars_complex
    87	    {E' H' M M' : Type*}
    88	    [NormedAddCommGroup E'] [NormedSpace ℂ E'] [TopologicalSpace H']
    89	    (I : ModelWithCorners ℂ E H) (J : ModelWithCorners ℂ E' H')
    90	    [TopologicalSpace M] [ChartedSpace H M]
    91	    [TopologicalSpace M'] [ChartedSpace H' M']
    92	    {f : M → M'} {x : M}
    93	    {f' : TangentSpace I x →L[ℂ] TangentSpace J (f x)}
    94	    (hf : HasMFDerivAt I J f x f') :
    95	    HasMFDerivAt (complexToRealModel I) (complexToRealModel J) f x
    96	      (f'.restrictScalars ℝ) := by
    97	  rw [HasMFDerivAt] at hf ⊢
    98	  exact ⟨hf.1, hf.2.restrictScalars ℝ⟩
    99	
   100	/-- A realified manifold derivative whose continuous-linear-map witness is the
   101	    scalar restriction of a complex-linear map can be lifted back to the
   102	    complex model. -/
   103	theorem HasMFDerivAt.of_restrict_scalars_complex
   104	    {E' H' M M' : Type*}
   105	    [NormedAddCommGroup E'] [NormedSpace ℂ E'] [TopologicalSpace H']
   106	    (I : ModelWithCorners ℂ E H) (J : ModelWithCorners ℂ E' H')
   107	    [TopologicalSpace M] [ChartedSpace H M]
   108	    [TopologicalSpace M'] [ChartedSpace H' M']
   109	    {f : M → M'} {x : M}
   110	    {f' : TangentSpace I x →L[ℂ] TangentSpace J (f x)}
   111	    (hf : HasMFDerivAt (complexToRealModel I) (complexToRealModel J) f x
   112	      (f'.restrictScalars ℝ)) :
   113	    HasMFDerivAt I J f x f' := by
   114	  rw [HasMFDerivAt] at hf ⊢
   115	  exact ⟨hf.1, hf.2.of_restrictScalars ℝ rfl⟩
   116	
   117	/-- Realifying the standard complex model gives the standard real model. -/
   118	theorem complexToRealModel_self :
   119	    complexToRealModel (𝓘(ℂ, E)) = 𝓘(ℝ, E) := by
   120	  apply ModelWithCorners.ext <;> rfl
   121	
   122	/-- Complex manifold differentiability implies differentiability for the
   123	underlying realified models. -/
   124	theorem MDifferentiableAt.restrict_scalars_complex
   125	    {E' H' M M' : Type*}
   126	    [NormedAddCommGroup E'] [NormedSpace ℂ E'] [TopologicalSpace H']
   127	    (I : ModelWithCorners ℂ E H) (J : ModelWithCorners ℂ E' H')
   128	    [TopologicalSpace M] [ChartedSpace H M]
   129	    [TopologicalSpace M'] [ChartedSpace H' M']
   130	    {f : M → M'} {x : M} (hf : MDifferentiableAt I J f x) :
   131	    MDifferentiableAt (complexToRealModel I) (complexToRealModel J) f x := by
   132	  rw [mdifferentiableAt_iff] at hf ⊢
   133	  exact ⟨hf.1, hf.2.restrictScalars ℝ⟩
   134	
   135	/-- The manifold derivative for a realified complex manifold is the scalar
   136	restriction of its complex manifold derivative. -/
   137	theorem mfderiv_complexToRealModel
   138	    {E' H' M M' : Type*}
   139	    [NormedAddCommGroup E'] [NormedSpace ℂ E'] [TopologicalSpace H']
   140	    (I : ModelWithCorners ℂ E H) (J : ModelWithCorners ℂ E' H')
   141	    [TopologicalSpace M] [ChartedSpace H M]
   142	    [TopologicalSpace M'] [ChartedSpace H' M']
   143	    {f : M → M'} {x : M} (hf : MDifferentiableAt I J f x) :
   144	    mfderiv (complexToRealModel I) (complexToRealModel J) f x =
   145	      (mfderiv I J f x).restrictScalars ℝ :=
   146	  (HasMFDerivAt.restrict_scalars_complex I J hf.hasMFDerivAt).mfderiv
   147	
   148	/-- A complex-smooth map is smooth between the corresponding realified
   149	manifolds. -/
   150	theorem ContMDiff.restrict_scalars_complex
   151	    {E' H' M M' : Type*}
   152	    [NormedAddCommGroup E'] [NormedSpace ℂ E'] [TopologicalSpace H']
   153	    (I : ModelWithCorners ℂ E H) (J : ModelWithCorners ℂ E' H')
   154	    {n : ℕ∞ω}
   155	    [TopologicalSpace M] [ChartedSpace H M] [IsManifold I n M]
   156	    [TopologicalSpace M'] [ChartedSpace H' M'] [IsManifold J n M']
   157	    {f : M → M'} (hf : ContMDiff I J n f) :
   158	    ContMDiff (complexToRealModel I) (complexToRealModel J) n f := by
   159	  rw [contMDiff_iff] at hf ⊢
   160	  exact ⟨hf.1, fun x y => (hf.2 x y).restrict_scalars ℝ⟩
   161	
   162	/-- Realification commutes with products of complex models. -/
   163	theorem complexToRealModel_prod
   164	    {E' H' : Type*}
   165	    [NormedAddCommGroup E'] [NormedSpace ℂ E'] [TopologicalSpace H']
   166	    (I : ModelWithCorners ℂ E H) (J : ModelWithCorners ℂ E' H') :
   167	    complexToRealModel (I.prod J) =
   168	      (complexToRealModel I).prod (complexToRealModel J) := by
   169	  apply ModelWithCorners.ext <;> rfl
   170	
   171	/-- A complex Lie group is a real Lie group for the realified model. -/
   172	instance complexToRealModel_lieGroup
   173	    {G : Type*} (I : ModelWithCorners ℂ E H) (n : ℕ∞ω)
   174	    [TopologicalSpace G] [ChartedSpace H G] [Group G] [LieGroup I n G] :
   175	    LieGroup (complexToRealModel I) n G := by
   176	  have hmul := ContMDiff.restrict_scalars_complex (I.prod I) I
   177	    (contMDiff_mul I n (G := G))
   178	  rw [complexToRealModel_prod] at hmul
   179	  have hinv := ContMDiff.restrict_scalars_complex I I
   180	    (contMDiff_inv I n (G := G))
   181	  exact { contMDiff_mul := hmul, contMDiff_inv := hinv }
   182	
   183	/-- Every tangent vector of the underlying real Lie group of a complex Lie
   184	group integrates to a global real one-parameter subgroup. -/
   185	theorem exists_real_oneParameterSubgroup_of_complexLieGroup
   186	    {G : Type*}
   187	    (I : ModelWithCorners ℂ E H)
   188	    [TopologicalSpace G] [ChartedSpace H G] [Group G]
   189	    [LieGroup I (minSmoothness ℂ 3) G]
   190	    [CompleteSpace E] [T2Space G] [I.Boundaryless]
   191	    (v : GroupLieAlgebra (complexToRealModel I) G) :
   192	    ∃ γ : ℝ → G, γ 0 = 1 ∧
   193	      IsMIntegralCurve γ
   194	        (mulInvariantVectorField (I := complexToRealModel I) v) ∧
   195	      ∀ s t : ℝ, γ (s + t) = γ s * γ t :=
   196	  let h : minSmoothness ℝ 3 = minSmoothness ℂ 3 := by
   197	    simp only [minSmoothness_of_isRCLikeNormedField]
   198	  letI : LieGroup I (minSmoothness ℝ 3) G :=
   199	    h ▸ (inferInstance : LieGroup I (minSmoothness ℂ 3) G)
   200	  exists_oneParameterSubgroup (I := complexToRealModel I) v
